title: Folio document fixture
description: One reproducible document input. A fixture states what the document contains, what it must satisfy, and where its content came from. Script coverage is declared explicitly so a corpus cannot silently drift toward one writing system.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used in reports and in baseline entries.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the document's primary language.

script_profile.description: The composition a fixture exercises. The four original values are left-to-right writing systems; `rtl-only` and `rtl-with-latin` cover right-to-left scripts and the bidi cases the coverage matrix asks for.

purpose.description: What this fixture exists to exercise, for example cjk-line-break or pagination-pressure.

adversarial.description: True for boundary and hostile inputs, which are carried deliberately rather than treated as failures to remove.

template.description: Template file to render, relative to assets/templates/. Defaults to the genre's template for the fixture language.

content.description: Placeholder values keyed by the template's placeholder text. Values are inserted verbatim, so they may contain inline HTML that the template already styles.

hard.description: Correctness requirements. A violation fails the corpus run.

soft.description: Craft objectives. A miss is reported for review, never failed.
